R129_spatiostructural_r93_residual_corre.difference_from_prior_work: R02 uses structural distance without a geographic kernel; R93 uses geographic distance without area/bedroom/washroom distance. R129 uses both in one neighborhood metric and calibrates residuals of the prequential R93 candidate rather than its R52 base.
R129_spatiostructural_r93_residual_corre.method: Use each month’s R93 candidate prediction as the base. For an outer month, derive past residual log(sold_price/R93_prediction) only from earlier safe R93 OOF rows. Within the same house type, find up to 50 earlier homes within 1.5 km and rank them by squared joint distance (spatial km/0.75, log area difference/0.25, bedroom difference/1.0, washroom difference/0.5). Weight the nearest residuals by a Gaussian of this joint distance and a 12-month recency half-life. Subtract the recency-weighted whole-type residual median, shrink by effective neighbor count/(effective neighbor count+25), clip to +/-0.03 log points, apply multiplicatively to R93, and round to the nearest dollar. Require 100 past rows of the type and 15 valid joint neighbors; missing query coordinates/structure or insufficient support leaves the R93 prediction unchanged. No current-month label is passed into calibration and no learner is retrained.

R132_asof_listing_avm_calibration.difference_from_prior_work: R22 explicitly excluded external AVM inputs, and the active safe-fold audit found only 14.109% of the eight-month development rows have an estimate dated by listing. R132 tests a causal, as-of-listing AVM fallback with past-only log-ratio calibration; estimates dated after listing are treated as unavailable. This does not use days_on_market or any post-listing estimate.
R132_asof_listing_avm_calibration.method: For each target month, use only training rows sold before that month. Require at least 500 past eligible AVM rows. For eligible heldout listings, replace the parent prediction with the calibrated AVM estimate rounded to the nearest dollar; for every ineligible listing, keep its validated parent prediction unchanged. The current-month sold price is used only for scoring and is never used to fit the calibration. No learner is trained.
